about_the_game:
The world is ending in chaos and no one cares. Through a series of freaky, interactive tableaux, a Dadaist, apocalyptic narrative soaks in... Not from a singular perspective but through a motley of sights from all walks of life. 

  • Increase the amount of blood you have by collecting it in a bucket.

  • Using only your computer-mouse, harvest living matter: Trap rats, dig through meat to find maggots, rip through the slabs with a chainsaw to create easily digestible chunks.

  • Upgrade your tools with your harvested stock.

  • Keep it going. More blood means more tools, more tools means more blood and you need more blood. You always need more blood.

  • And continue about your life as you normally would while this is happening. The game is meant to be played alongside your normal, routine-use of your computer. Reply to emails, take video calls, do whatever you normally do while you play to get the full experience.

Features:

  • Resizable game-space! You decide how much of the screen the game covers. Using your computer's capability for spawning see-through windows, the game stays front-and-center while you work, study and stalk your prey! You can even play other games behind it!

  • Nonlinear progression through horrifying, lore-rich chapters in different environments and skins! (literally, skins! Some flesh and fat too if you're into that!)

  • Systemic gameplay where using items effectively means more blood faster, and more story progression sooner!

  • Unique combination of the clicker-idler with interactive fiction genre! The fiction is optional and is something you find through gameplay.

  • Full localization support for supported languages, even in the demo!

  • An online Leaderboard, also in the demo!

  • Automatically saves and loads progress

This is a Dadaist game, the first of its kind. Hopefully not the last.

Dadaism is an early 20th-century avant-garde, anti-establishment movement that emerged as a protest against the senselessness of the politics of its time. Characterized by its embrace of the illogical, irrational, and absurd, Dadaists challenged traditional artistic, social, and cultural conventions, ultimately influencing the Surrealists.

In the face of the dichotomy between the current political/ideological chaos and the sheer gall of the ineptitude of our corrupt leaders, both nationally and globally, and the tightening stranglehold of tyrannical power-grabs & far-reaching censorship while political assassinations and coverups are being carried out with obvious patsies and tampered-if-not-withheld evidence, and the blatant lies pushed through the bowels of the media by tech companies working for private government organizations who in turn have been shown to be blackmailed by foreign interests who are exploiting us and using our government to further the violent ends of their own religious delusions...

Let's just say the State of affairs is on a spiral of decline far steeper than it was when Dadaism first formed. In response, the culture has shifted. Everything is more emotionally cataclysmic, spiritually catatonic, and psychologically castrated. it's only natural for a human response to reflect this darkness through grim absurdity. Keep the blood flowing and continue about your life as you normally would while this is happening.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Linux distribution released after 2018
  • Processor: x86_32 CPU with SSE2 support, x86_64 CPU with SSE4.2 support, ARMv7 or ARMv8 CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 512 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13
  • Processor: x86_64 or ARM CPU (Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics with full OpenGL 3.3 support
  • Storage: 512 MB available space
